web.title: AI Image Generation Models: The Complete 2026 Guide ...
web.description:
AI image generation models in 2026, by specialty: Nano Banana Pro (instruction-following, editing), Seedream 4.5 (text rendering, 4K, product), FLUX.2 (photorealism, open weights), GPT Image (world knowledge, complex prompts), Imagen 4 (natural photo look), Qwen Image (open-source value), Z-Image Turbo (0.5 credits, volume work), Ideogram 4 (typography). Last verified June 2026.

But underneath every product is a **model** — and in 2026 the model, not the app, determines what your output looks like. Gemini's come from Nano Banana.

## The major model families in 2026
### Seedream (ByteDance)
Seedream 4.5 (4 credits) renders **text better than almost anything**, outputs up to 4K natively, and excels at product and commercial photography looks. It's also fast.

### Imagen (Google DeepMind)
Less controllable for edits than Nano Banana; think of it as the camera, Nano Banana as the darkroom.

### Grok Imagine (xAI)
X's image model (5 credits), notable for speed, a looser content policy than most rivals, and a distinctive photorealistic style.

## Quick comparison table
| Model | Maker | Credits/image* | Standout strength |
|-|-|-|-|
| Seedream 4.5 | ByteDance | 4 | Text rendering, 4K, product |
| Nano Banana | Google | 4 | Edits, identity preservation |
| Nano Banana Pro | Google | 15 | Hardest edits and layouts |
